name: check_repair_status
description: Look up the status of a car that is already at the shop. Verifies with the customer's last name plus either the phone number on the ticket or the repair order number. Ask for the last name and call right away: the caller ID is checked automatically, so a caller phoning from the number on the ticket needs nothing else. The repair order number is at the top of the written estimate if they got one, or on the deposit receipt if they already dropped the car off and paid a deposit. If found=false with 'needs', ask for what's missing; if it can't verify, offer to take a message. If it returns ok=false with invalid_input, re-ask for that field. If it returns timeout or internal_error, apologize and offer to take a message.

last_name.description: Customer last name as on the repair order

phone.description: Phone number on the repair order, digits only
